decision_reason: `runtime-event-misclassification` and `silent-fallback-to-RunFailedEvent` are illegal_state + property risk classes. Proptest enumeration over the 16-variant RuntimeJournalEvent alphabet plus pass-through invariants (`mapped.seq() == seq`, `mapped.run_id() == event.run_id()`) is the natural primary lane. Rust-local proptest sweeps the success and failure paths simultaneously; no silent clamp/unwrap surface.

`rust-local` + `bounded_state` mandate Verus as the refinement lane. The Verus mirror at `verification/verus/extern_vb_jnz9_journal_event_seq_valid.rs` (near line-range 616-624 for `MirrorJournalEvent::RunResumed` and 715/748/792/839 for `run_id`/`seq`/`is_valid` mirrors per `codebase-map.md`) is the production-binding target. The WEAK_EXTERN mirror proves the production shape stays in sync via `scripts/check-verus-production-binding.sh`.

Mapper change must not introduce `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`/`todo`/`unimplemented`/`dbg`/`as i64` cast. `scripts/check-panic-surface.sh`, `scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.sh`, and `scripts/check-source-length.sh` are the canonical source-lint gates; `scripts/check-verus-production-binding.sh` enforces the Verus mirror drift gate.

`arithmetic-overflow` + `no-panic` are arithmetic_overflow + panic_freedom risk classes. Proptest sweeps the `u64` input space (PROPTEST_CASES=65536) with explicit boundary sentinels (`u64::MAX`, `i64::MAX` as u64, `i64::MAX+1` as u64, `0`, and a realistic UNIX timestamp) to assert `convert_resume_timestamp` returns `Ok(chrono)` for legal values and `Err(RuntimeError::ResumeTimestampOverflow { run, timestamp })` for overflow. No `unwrap`, no `expect`, no clamp, no wrap is asserted.

`arithmetic-overflow` is a Verus-mandated `verus` rust-local + arithmetic lane. The Verus spec binds `convert_resume_timestamp` to the production `boundary_storage_event` Resumed arm via the existing `MirrorJournalEvent::RunResumed` mirror at `verification/verus/extern_vb_jnz9_journal_event_seq_valid.rs`. Companion to proptest PO-003 which sweeps random inputs; Verus proves the invariant holds for arbitrary inputs via the spec `requires`/`ensures` post-conditions.

`no-panic` is a source-lint requirement. `scripts/check-panic-surface.sh` and `scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.sh` reject `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`/`todo` and any `as i64` cast on `u64`. The mapper must use `i64::try_from(timestamp_u64)` followed by `DateTime::<Utc>::from_timestamp(_, 0)`; any other conversion path is rejected at lint time.

`storage-dispatch-totality-loss` is bounded_transition + compile-time-exhaustiveness. Cargo-test regression extends the 16-variant enumeration at `crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/tests/chunk_004.rs:1077-1090` to assert every variant reaches a typed event or explicit no-op, never the catch-all `RunFailedEvent`. After vb-edvbj deletes the catch-all, exhaustive match becomes a compile-time gate; cargo-test complements the compile-time check at runtime.

Source-lint enforces that `StorageRuntimeJournal::storage_event` (`crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/chunk_002.rs:270-303`) has no `_ =>` arm once vb-edvbj lands. Until vb-edvbj lands, the lint surfaces the unused-variable or non-exhaustive-match warning as a structural hazard.

`single-clone-invariant-regression` is bounded_state + performance. The existing regression test `storage_event_clones_the_event_exactly_once_per_dispatch` at `crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/tests/chunk_002.rs:410-493` is extended with a `Resumed` arm sample. `STORAGE_EVENT_CLONE_COUNT` (`crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/chunk_002.rs:319-321`) is a test-only `AtomicUsize`; cargo-test asserts the counter increases by exactly 1.

`recovery-state-flip-to-Failed` is temporal_safety. Per master declaration TLA+ is removed; loom + proptest covers the temporal shape. Loom exercises scheduler interleavings for `Shard::handle_resume` ↔ `append_resumed_event` ↔ storage dispatch; proptest sweeps replay alphabet: `RunResumed → LifecycleState::Active` (passing scenario) vs the buggy `RunFailedEvent → LifecycleState::Failed` (regression scenario).

`seq-discard` + `runid-derivation` are equality risk classes. Proptest random enumerates `(timestamp: u64, seq: EventSeq, run: RunId)` and asserts `mapped_event.seq() == seq` and `mapped_event.run_id() == event.run_id()` for every input. No derivation, no zeroing of run, no increment of seq.

Verus rust-local proof over `MirrorJournalEvent::RunResumed` at `verification/verus/extern_vb_jnz9_journal_event_seq_valid.rs` proves pass-through for arbitrary input; companion to proptest (which sweeps random inputs). The WEAK_EXTERN mirror anchors `MirrorJournalEvent::RunResumed { run, seq, timestamp }` to production `JournalEvent::RunResumed { run, seq, timestamp }`.

`typed-error` + `diagnostic-context-loss` are illegal_state + property. Proptest asserts `RuntimeError::ResumeTimestampOverflow` is a struct variant carrying `run: RunId` and `timestamp: u64` (not a unit variant). `Display` and `Debug` are exercised via `to_string()` assertions. The proptest is paired with the source-lint gate that confirms `RuntimeError` is `#[non_exhaustive]` (already verified at `crates/vb_runtime/src/error/mod.rs:8`).

`RuntimeError` must be `#[non_exhaustive]` (already true at `crates/vb_runtime/src/error/mod.rs:8`). Source-lint verifies the new variant is a struct variant with `run` and `timestamp` fields — no unit variant permitted. `scripts/check-error-exhaustiveness.sh` plus a code-review checklist enforces the shape.

`vb_runtime` does not use Flux refinement types. The mapper's value domain is bounded by `u64::MAX` (proven by proptest enumeration PO-003 + boundary sentinels) and `DateTime<Utc>` is constructed from a known-good i64. Flux refinement types would not add coverage; the conversion is total over `u64` by construction.

`crates/vb_runtime` is `#[forbid(unsafe_code)]` at the crate root (`crates/vb_runtime/src/lib.rs:1`); the mapper site `crates/vb_runtime/src/journal/chunk_002.rs` contains zero `unsafe` blocks (`grep -n unsafe` returns empty). There are no raw pointers, `MaybeUninit`, FFI, or `repr(C)` layouts in the mapper or its helpers. No UB surface exists for Miri to detect.

This is not a parser/codec/byte-input surface. `StorageRuntimeJournal::storage_event` takes a strongly-typed `RuntimeJournalEvent` (16-variant enum) and a strongly-typed `EventSeq`. The hostile-input boundary is fully covered by proptest enumeration PO-003 + boundary sentinels (`u64::MAX`, `i64::MAX` as u64, `i64::MAX+1` as u64). Random byte-fuzzing adds no coverage; proptest at PROPTEST_CASES=65536 is strictly stronger for this domain.

Kani symbolic execution would add no coverage beyond proptest PO-003 (u64 sweep with boundary sentinels including u64::MAX and i64::MAX+1) and PO-007 (16-variant enumeration). The input space is small (16-variant enum × u64 × RunId × EventSeq); proptest with PROPTEST_CASES=65536 plus explicit overflow sentinels is strictly stronger than Kani CBMC bounds for this claim set. Kani-derived evidence is implicitly present via the proptest pass-through and the cargo-test single-clone atomic counter.

TLA+ is removed per master declaration `velvet-ballistics-MASTER.md`. The temporal-resume refinement obligation RRO-TLA-RESUME-001 at `verification/tla/rust-refinement-obligations.jsonl:6` is reframed as a loom + proptest surface (PO-005). The mapper arm is downstream of the FSM refinement target; the source-ref expansion at `shard/lifecycle/chunk_001.rs:291-367` plus `journal/chunk_002.rs:270-303` (new mapper arm) preserves the refinement harness shape even though the obligation is satisfied via loom, not TLA+.

The Verus mirror at `verification/verus/extern_vb_jnz9_journal_event_seq_valid.rs:616-624` must stay in sync with production `JournalEvent::RunResumed` shape. The drift gate `scripts/check-verus-production-binding.sh` enforces binding; `scripts/check-production-inner-drift.sh` enforces mirror content drift. The mapper change adds an arm but does NOT alter the production shape; mirrors stay accurate. The drift gate is the source-lint companion to PO-001 (Verus spec binding).
